long_biography.plain_text:
Richard Sands briefly worked as a delivery driver during a break from college before earning a doctorate in social psychology. He joined the family's wine business in 1979 and rose through executive vice president, president and chief operating officer to become chief executive. The company had been founded by his father Marvin, giving Sands an established commercial platform rather than an independent start.

During his leadership, Constellation expanded through organic growth and a sustained acquisition programme, adding international wine and spirits businesses and becoming a broad beverage-alcohol group. His younger brother Robert succeeded him as chief executive after fourteen years, while Richard continued as chairman and later executive vice chairman. Both brothers retired as executives in 2022; Richard remains a non-management director and a participant in the wider Sands family ownership group.
